_comment: Exclusion plane of secret neutrino interactions, couplings to nu_e and nu_tau (g_ab = g for a = b in {e, tau}, a non-universal texture of two flavors; with delta_CP = 212 deg its mass-basis couplings U^T G U are complex), scalar mediator of mass m_phi_eV: the flavor-triangle analysis of the dark-portal planes (projected 2050 measurement, pion sources) with the propagation of dp_si. Couplings from 1e-6, so that every mass column reaches the no-effect region (at 1e-4 the resonant absorption near 1 MeV already gives Delta chi^2 = 5). Read per mediator mass at Delta chi^2 = 3.84 (decided 2026-10-13 for the dark portal's planes).
name: pion_2050_case_5_si_e_tau_gal

solver._comment: Physics of the dark-portal planes (pion_2050_case_5: the projection's mixing, m_lightest = 0.01 eV, 1/3:2/3:0 sources with E^-2.5 up to z = 4), with secret interactions in place of the dark portal (dp_si: scalar mediator, Majorana neutrinos, the full cross sections of arXiv:2107.13568 with the coherent double-scalar coupling, relics at rest). Grid: 400 energy bins, one redshift step per bin (energy-averaged fractions within 1e-5 of 1600 bins and four steps per bin at nu_tau, 5 MeV, g = 0.1; tools/si_validation.py convergence), the grid extended tenfold above 30 PeV.

_comment_galactic: With the Galactic component (tools/make_galactic_configs.py; Mauricio, 2026-10-14): CRINGE x norm_gal (Gaussian 0.91 +- 0.18, IceCube 2026), dark-portal emission points in 3-D; the data are the flavor surface and IceCube 2026's astrophysical spectrum (10 TeV - 1 PeV) against the extragalactic flux at the Earth; the extragalactic normalization (norm_astro, no prior) and spectral index (p_index) float. Source compositions fixed at pion decay (1/3, 2/3, 0), Galactic and extragalactic (nominal).
